text.name: Caterpie
text.flavor: Perhaps because it would like to grow up quickly, it has a voracious appetite, eating a hundred leaves a day.

text.name: Metapod
text.flavor: Its shell is filled with a thick liquid. All of the cells throughout its body are being rebuilt in preparation for evolution.

text.name: Butterfree
text.flavor: Its wings are covered in toxic scales. If it finds bird Pokémon going after Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles its scales on them to drive them off.

text.name: Paras
text.flavor: Whether it's due to a lack of moisture or a lack of nutrients, in Alola the mushrooms on Paras don't grow up quite right.

text.name: Scyther
text.flavor: Its two sharp scythes are more than just weapons. It uses them with dexterity to dress its prey before eating.

attacks.label: GX
attacks.name: Guillotine
attacks.text: (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules.label: Pokémon-GX rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Charmander
text.flavor: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

text.name: Charmeleon
text.flavor: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

attacks.label: GX
attacks.name: Flare Blitz
attacks.text: (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules.label: Pokémon-GX rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Magmar
text.flavor: Its entire body is burning. When it breathes, the temperature rises. When it sneezes, flames shoot out!

text.name: Psyduck
text.flavor: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

text.name: Slowpoke

attacks.name: Yawn
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

text.flavor: Alolan home cooking involves drying Slowpoke tails and then simmering them into a salty stew.

text.name: Staryu

attacks.name: Numbing Water
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.

attacks.name: Star Stream
attacks.text: Attach 2 {Water} Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.label: GX
attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage times the amount of {Water} Energy attached to this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules.label: Pokémon-GX rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Magikarp
text.flavor: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

attacks.label: GX
attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules.label: Pokémon-GX rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Lapras
text.flavor: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

text.name: Vaporeon

attacks.name: Bubble Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Clean, clear waters are its usual habitat. When it's about to be attacked by an invading enemy, it dives into the water to hide.

text.name: Pikachu
text.flavor: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

attacks.label: GX
attacks.name: Spark Ball
attacks.text: (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules.label: Pokémon-GX rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Voltorb
text.flavor: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

text.name: Electrode

attacks.name: Electroblast
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

text.flavor: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”

text.name: Jolteon

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Electromagnetic Wall
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.

text.name: Zapdos

attacks.name: Hurricane Call
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. For each heads, search your deck for a {Lightning} Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

text.name: Ekans

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

text.flavor: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

text.name: Ekans
text.flavor: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.

text.name: Arbok

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Last Pattern
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, discard 2 random cards from your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Rocket Tail
attacks.text: If Jessie & James is in your discard pile, this attack does 80 more damage.

text.flavor: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.

text.name: Koffing
text.flavor: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

text.name: Weezing

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Surrender Now
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is discarded with the effect of Jessie & James, you may have your opponent discard a card from their hand. (They discard that card after the effect of Jessie & James.)

text.flavor: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

text.name: Jynx
text.flavor: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

attacks.label: GX
attacks.name: Psycrush
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules.label: Pokémon-GX rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Mew
text.flavor: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

text.name: Geodude
text.flavor: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

text.name: Graveler

attacks.name: Mudslide
attacks.text: Discard 2 {Fighting} Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.

text.name: Golem

attacks.name: Rock Slide
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 3 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.label: GX
attacks.name: Rocky Avalanche
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 100 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance). (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules.label: Pokémon-GX rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Cubone

attacks.name: Sharpshooting
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: The skull it wears on its head is that of its dead mother. According to some, it will evolve when it comes to terms with the pain of her death.

text.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Lead
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

text.name: Clefairy
text.flavor: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

text.name: Clefable
text.flavor: It can't help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren't many people or Pokémon.

text.name: Jigglypuff
text.flavor: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

attacks.name: Rolling Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

attacks.label: GX
attacks.name: Lovely Star
attacks.text: Heal all damage from this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules.label: Pokémon-GX rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Mr. Mime

attacks.name: Happy Mime
attacks.text: Each player draws a card.

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

text.flavor: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

attacks.label: GX
attacks.name: Sky Legends
attacks.text: Shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra {Fire}, {Water}, and {Lightning} Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 110 damage to 3 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules.label: TAG TEAM rule
rules.text: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

text.name: Farfetch'd
text.flavor: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

text.name: Chansey

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

text.flavor: It seems that other Pokémon's efforts to take its delicious, nutritious egg away from it caused Chansey to get faster at fleeing.

text.name: Kangaskhan

attacks.name: Parental Fury
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

text.flavor: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.

text.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Curiosity
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

attacks.name: Spin Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

text.flavor: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

text.name: Eevee
text.flavor: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

text.name: Snorlax
text.flavor: It doesn't do anything other than eat and sleep. When prompted to make a serious effort, though, it apparently displays awesome power.

text.name: Bill's Analysis
effect: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal up to 2 Trainer cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Blaine's Last Stand
effect: You can play this card only when it is the last card in your hand.
Draw 2 cards for each {Fire} Pokémon you have in play.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Brock's Grit
effect: Shuffle 6 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Brock's Pewter City Gym
effect: Onix-GX (both yours and your opponent's) take 40 less damage from the opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Brock's Training
effect: Attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Geodude, Graveler, Golem, Onix-GX, Cubone, Rhyhorn, Rhydon, or Sudowoodo.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Erika's Hospitality
effect: You can play this card only if you have 4 or fewer other cards in your hand.
Draw a card for each of your opponent's Pokémon in play.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Giovanni's Exile
effect: Discard up to 2 of your Benched Pokémon that have no damage counters on them and all cards attached to them.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Jessie & James
effect: Each player discards 2 cards from their hand. Your opponent discards first.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Koga's Trap
effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Lt. Surge's Strategy
effect: You can play this card only if you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent.
During this turn, you can play 3 Supporter cards (including this card).

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Misty's Cerulean City Gym
effect: The attacks of Starmie-GX (both yours and your opponent's) do 40 more damage to the opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

rules.text: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Misty's Determination
effect: Discard a card from your hand. If you do, look at the top 8 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Misty's Water Command
effect: Move any number of {Water} Energy from your Pokémon to your Psyduck, Horsea, Staryu, Starmie-GX, Magikarp, Gyarados, or Lapras in any way you like.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Pokémon Center Lady
effect: Heal 60 damage and remove all Special Conditions from 1 of your Pokémon.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Sabrina's Suggestion
effect: Your opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a Supporter card you find there and use the effect of that card as the effect of this card.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

attacks.label: GX
attacks.name: Sky Legends
attacks.text: Shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra {Fire}, {Water}, and {Lightning} Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 110 damage to 3 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules.label: TAG TEAM rule
rules.text: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

text.name: Giovanni's Exile
effect: Discard up to 2 of your Benched Pokémon that have no damage counters on them and all cards attached to them.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

text.name: Jessie & James
effect: Each player discards 2 cards from their hand. Your opponent discards first.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

attacks.label: GX
attacks.name: Sky Legends
attacks.text: Shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra {Fire}, {Water}, and {Lightning} Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 110 damage to 3 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules.label: TAG TEAM rule
rules.text: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

text.name: Scyther

attacks.name: Twin Play
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Scyther and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

text.flavor: While young, they live together deep in the mountains, training themselves in how to fight with their scythes and move at high speeds.

text.name: Rowlet
text.flavor: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

text.name: Dartrix

attacks.name: Sharp Blade Quill
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Leaf Blade
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

text.flavor: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

text.name: Wimpod

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Wimp Out
abilities.text: During your first turn, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

text.flavor: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

text.name: Pheromosa

attacks.name: White Ray
attacks.text: If you have only 1 Prize card remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.

text.flavor: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

text.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

text.flavor: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

text.name: Charmeleon

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Burning Fighter
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may discard the top 5 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are {Fire} Energy cards, attach them to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the air temperature to unbearably high levels.

text.name: Alolan Vulpix

attacks.name: Beacon
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

text.name: Wooper
text.flavor: When the temperature cools in the evening, they emerge from water to seek food along the shore.

text.name: Quagsire

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Wash Out
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a {Water} Energy from 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of {Water} Energy attached to this Pokémon.

text.flavor: This carefree Pokémon has an easygoing nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

text.name: Froakie

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Frubbles
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any {Water} Energy attached to it, it has no Retreat Cost.

text.flavor: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

text.name: Frogadier

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Gale Shuriken
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

text.flavor: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.

text.name: Voltorb

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Floating Electrons
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Energy attached to it, it has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

text.name: Xurkitree

attacks.name: Dazzle Blast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Cablegram
attacks.text: If you have exactly 3 Prize cards remaining, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

text.flavor: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.

text.name: Seviper

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: More Poison
abilities.text: Put 1 more damage counter on your opponent's Poisoned Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Venomous Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

text.flavor: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

text.name: Shuppet
text.flavor: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

text.name: Inkay

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

text.flavor: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

text.name: Malamar

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Psychic Recharge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a {Psychic} Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

text.flavor: It lures its prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids.

text.name: Poipole

attacks.name: Spit Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Knockout Reviver
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is Knocked Out, your opponent can't take any Prize cards for it.

text.flavor: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

text.name: Sudowoodo

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Roadblock
abilities.text: Your opponent can't have more than 4 Benched Pokémon. If they have 5 or more Benched Pokémon, they discard Benched Pokémon until they have 4 Pokémon on the Bench. If more than one effect changes the number of Benched Pokémon allowed, use the smaller number.

text.flavor: To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.

text.name: Riolu

attacks.name: Detect
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

text.flavor: It's tough enough to run right through the night, and it's also a hard worker, but it's still just a youngster.

text.name: Lucario

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Precognitive Aura
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Garchomp in play, you may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Missile Jab
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

text.flavor: They can detect the species of a living being—and its emotions—from over half a mile away. They control auras and hunt their prey in packs.

text.name: Rockruff

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

text.flavor: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

text.name: Buzzwole

attacks.name: Sledgehammer
attacks.text: If your opponent has exactly 4 Prize cards remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Swing Around
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.

text.flavor: A mysterious life-form called an Ultra Beast. Witnesses saw it pulverize a dump truck with a single punch.

text.name: Zorua
text.flavor: It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

text.name: Guzzlord

attacks.name: Lord's Valley
attacks.text: If you have exactly 2, 4, or 6 Prize cards remaining, discard the top 10 cards of your deck.

text.flavor: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.

text.name: Magnemite

attacks.name: Searching Magnet
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 {Metal} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

text.flavor: It sends out electromagnetic waves, which let it float through the air. Touching it while it's eating electricity will give you a full-body shock.

text.name: Magneton

attacks.name: Zap Cannon
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Zap Cannon during your next turn.

text.flavor: It has about three times the electrical power of Magnemite. For some reason, outbreaks of this Pokémon happen when lots of sunspots appear.

text.name: Magnezone

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Magnetic Circuit
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a {Metal} Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Zap Cannon
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Zap Cannon during your next turn.

text.flavor: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

text.name: Beldum

attacks.name: Core Beam
attacks.text: Discard a {Metal} Energy from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.

text.name: Metang

attacks.name: Core Beam
attacks.text: Discard a {Metal} Energy from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.

text.name: Celesteela

attacks.name: Moon Raker
attacks.text: If the total of both players' remaining Prize cards is exactly 6, this attack can be used for {Metal}.

text.flavor: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.

text.name: Kartana

attacks.name: Divine Paper
attacks.text: If your opponent has exactly 6 Prize cards remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.

text.flavor: One of the Ultra Beast life-forms, it was observed cutting down a gigantic steel tower with one stroke of its blade.

text.name: Ralts

attacks.name: Draining Kiss
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

text.flavor: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

text.name: Kirlia
text.flavor: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

text.name: Diancie

attacks.name: Sparkling Wish
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from 1 of your Pokémon and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Diamond Storm
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from each of your {Fairy} Pokémon.

text.flavor: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

text.name: Altaria

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Fight Song
abilities.text: Your {Dragon} Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

text.flavor: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

text.name: Gible
